preconditions.description: Number of vertices is between 2 and 100,000.
Number of ants is between 1 and 10,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u_i <= n and 1 <= v_i <= n for u_i, v_i in edges)
preconditions.description: All edge vertices are within the range [1, n].
The number of edges is exactly n - 1, forming a tree.

preconditions.expression: all(a_i != b_i and c_i != d_i for a_i, b_i, c_i, d_i in ants)
preconditions.description: Each ant's favorite pairs are distinct.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= n and 1 <= b_i <= n and 1 <= c_i <= n and 1 <= d_i <= n for a_i, b_i, c_i, d_i in ants)
preconditions.description: All favorite pair vertices are within the range [1, n].

postconditions.description: If the output is 'YES', there are exactly m lines indicating which pair each ant should use.

postconditions.expression: if return_value == 'YES': all(pair in [1, 2] for pair in output_pairs)
postconditions.description: Each line in the output indicates either the first or second pair.

postconditions.expression: if return_value == 'YES': all(any((a_i, b_i) in connected_components[color] or (b_i, a_i) in connected_components[color] for color in range(m)) for a_i, b_i, c_i, d_i in ants)
postconditions.description: For each ant, at least one of its favorite pairs is connected by edges of a single color.
